items.title: Bitbucket DC 未授权任意文件读取
items.title_zh: Bitbucket DC 未授权任意文件读取
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可直接读取应用根目录下特定文件，需预知文件名与路径，导致源码、配置等敏感信息泄露。
items.action_zh: 升级到 9.4.26 或 10.2.8 及以上版本
items.repro_note: 未授权请求访问应用根目录文件的接口，需预知精确文件名与路径
items.impact_scope: 企业代码托管平台，内网高价值目标
items.description: This Arbitrary File Access vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions. Exploitation requires prior knowledge of the target file's exact name and path; this vulnerability does not allow attackers to enumerate or list directory contents.

items.title: Vitess 反射型XSS 需诱导点击
items.title_zh: Vitess 反射型XSS 需诱导点击
items.summary_zh: 攻击者构造vttablet HTTP端口URL诱导运维人员点击，可在同源执行JS并读取页面敏感数据。
items.action_zh: 升级到 0.23.5 或 0.24.2 及以上版本
items.repro_note: vttablet 15999端口构造反射XSS链接，需诱导用户点击触发
items.impact_scope: 分布式数据库中间件，内网运维面

items.title: Wavlink路由器堆溢出 未认证远程
items.title_zh: Wavlink路由器堆溢出 未认证远程
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可向WN530HG4B管理接口发送构造请求触发堆溢出，导致设备崩溃或被远程控制。
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复，建议关闭WAN侧管理并限制访问
items.repro_note: 向设备HTTP管理接口发送构造请求，触发堆溢出
items.description: A vulnerability was found in Wavlink WN530HG4B M30HG4B_V260724. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

items.title: Nutanix Prism 伪造头认证绕过
items.title_zh: Nutanix Prism 伪造头认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者在请求中加入伪造的内部管理HTTP头即可绕过认证，完全控制Prism Element管理API。
items.action_zh: 升级至官方修复版本，临时限制管理接口访问来源
items.repro_note: 未授权请求管理API并添加伪造内部管理HTTP头绕过认证
items.impact_scope: 超融合管理平台，控制整个集群
items.description: An unauthenticated remote attacker can bypass authentication and gain full access to administrative API endpoints in Nutanix Prism Element by including a crafted internal management HTTP header. Successful exploitation allows the attacker to execute root-level commands on all Controller VMs (CVMs) in the cluster, leading to complete cluster destruction and unauthorized access to VM memory and virtual disks.

items.title: Podman 镜像与检查点混淆 不安全执行
items.title_zh: Podman 镜像与检查点混淆 不安全执行
items.summary_zh: 攻击者构造伪装成检查点的镜像，用户执行podman run时镜像可控制自身执行方式，突破容器隔离预期。
items.action_zh: 升级到 5.8.8 或 6.1.3 及以上版本
items.repro_note: 使用特制检查点镜像执行 podman run，观察执行配置被镜像控制
items.impact_scope: 容器宿主工具，影响容器隔离边界
items.description: This allowed easy transfer of checkpoints between systems. Conflating container images and checkpoints in `podman run` allows inherently insecure behavior as the image can now control how it is executed.

items.title: Argo CD 授权校验错误 越权操作
items.title_zh: Argo CD 授权校验错误 越权操作
items.summary_zh: 攻击者利用授权校验缺陷绕过权限限制，对其他项目资源执行越权读写，影响应用部署与集群安全。
items.action_zh: 升级到 3.3.15 及以上版本
items.repro_note: 以受限账号调用Argo CD API，验证跨项目越权读写资源
items.impact_scope: GitOps发布平台，掌握集群部署权限
items.description: ### Credits The Argo CD team would like to thank @RealFakeAccount, @AdamKorcz, @0xshylines, @thevilledev, @HenriWilliams, @cherez0ff, @ARSB1, and @zwindler for responsibly disclosing this issue according to our [security reporting guidelines](https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/blob/master/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability).

items.title: KEDA 命名空间管理员提权至集群管理员
items.title_zh: KEDA 命名空间管理员提权至集群管理员
items.summary_zh: 具备命名空间管理权限者利用KEDA越权读取集群Secret并跨命名空间创建Job，提权为集群管理员。
items.action_zh: 升级到 2.21.0 及以上版本
items.repro_note: 授予命名空间管理员权限后经KEDA资源读集群Secret并创建Job
items.impact_scope: K8s集群组件，横向提权跳板
items.description: This is effectively privilege escalation from namespace admin to cluster admin in real environments: a cluster-wide Secret read alone is enough to find a token for a more privileged ServiceAccount, and the cluster-wide `batch/jobs` create lets the attacker run a workload in any namespace whose Pod Security Admission level permits it (or that is PSA-exempt, such as `kube-system` , `kyverno`) to reach the node filesystem and a control-plane kubeconfig.

items.title: 防火墙GeoIP路径遍历 root写文件
items.title_zh: 防火墙GeoIP路径遍历 root写文件
items.summary_zh: 拥有防火墙别名编辑权限者可配置恶意GeoIP源，通过归档路径穿越将任意内容以root权限写入目标目录。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复信息，临时收紧别名编辑权限
items.repro_note: 以别名编辑权限设置恶意GeoIP URL，上传含../的归档触发写入
items.impact_scope: 防火墙管理系统，边界安全设备
items.description: A user with Firewall Alias Edit privilege can configure an attacker-controlled GeoIP source URL and supply an archive whose country code traverses into another existing directory, causing attacker-controlled content to be written as root with an -IPv4 or -IPv6 suffix. A crafted newsyslog fragment and oversized log file can use the default hourly root cron job to execute commands as root, resulting in complete firewall compromise.

items.title: Neptune Gremlin反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 拥有标准数据库权限的认证用户经Gremlin导入接口反序列化恶意数据执行代码，并获取内部服务凭证。
items.repro_note: 以数据库账号向Gremlin导入组件提交恶意序列化数据
items.impact_scope: 云托管图数据库，可获取云内凭证
items.description: Deserialization of untrusted data in the Gremlin graph data import component in Amazon Neptune engine might allow an authenticated remote actor with standard database permissions to execute arbitrary code and access internal service credentials. To remediate this issue, users not enrolled in auto-update should upgrade to Amazon Neptune engine version 1.5.0.0.(Backports to 1.4.8.1 and 1.4.7.1)
